output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(o.gross_margin) / SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM marts.fct_orders o
WHERE o.is_revenue = true
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: Gross margin percent is calculated as sum(gross_margin) / sum(net_revenue), multiplied by 100 and rounded to 2 decimals. It covers completed orders only (is_revenue = true) with an order date in fiscal year 2025, which is the same as the calendar year.
